title: Quantum Amplitude Amplification and Estimation
authors: Gilles Brassard, Peter Høyer, Michele Mosca, Alain Tapp
supports: Sections 2–4: amplification construction and amplitude-estimation error theorem.

title: Tight bounds on quantum searching
authors: Michel Boyer, Gilles Brassard, Peter Høyer, Alain Tapp
supports: Multiple/unknown solution counts, randomized iteration lengths and query scaling. Abstract and author-paper indexed text checked; not a full proof audit.

title: Fixed-point quantum search with an optimal number of queries
authors: Theodore J. Yoder, Guang Hao Low, Isaac L. Chuang
supports: Equations 1, 13–14: bounded polynomial and phase schedule; pi/3 distinction.

title: A Quantum Algorithm for Finding the Minimum
supports: Threshold algorithm and O(sqrt N) bounded-error oracle complexity; author-hosted full text at cs.au.dk/~ivan/findmin.pdf checked.

title: Quantum Algorithm for the Collision Problem
authors: Gilles Brassard, Peter Høyer, Alain Tapp
supports: Section 2/Theorem 1: k + sqrt(N/k) query/storage tradeoff and two-to-one promise.

title: The phase-estimation procedure
supports: QFT circuit, controlled phases, QPE exact/inexact analysis and nearest-grid probability bound.

title: Arbitrary accuracy iterative phase estimation algorithm as a two qubit benchmark
authors: Miroslav Dobšíček, Göran Johansson, Vitaly Shumeiko, Göran Wendin
supports: Single-ancilla QFT-based iteration, comparison with Kitaev and powered-U resource warning.

title: Semiclassical Fourier Transform for Quantum Computation
supports: Terminal Fourier measurement replaced by classical feed-forward; not coherent-transform equivalence.

title: Polynomial-Time Algorithms for Prime Factorization and Discrete Logarithms on a Quantum Computer
supports: Sections 3–6: arithmetic, QFT, order finding, factoring postprocessing and discrete logarithms.

title: Shor’s algorithm
supports: Classical factoring reduction and efficient modular multiplication powers.

title: Quantum algorithms for algebraic problems
authors: Andrew M. Childs, Wim van Dam
supports: Sections III–IV: group Fourier sampling and abelian hidden-subgroup model; nonabelian boundaries.

title: Amplitude Estimation without Phase Estimation
authors: Yohichi Suzuki, Shumpei Uno, Rudy Raymond, Tomoki Tanaka, Tamiya Onodera, Naoki Yamamoto
supports: Section 3: likelihood from Grover-depth measurements; statistical rather than universal finite-sample guarantees.

title: Iterative Quantum Amplitude Estimation
authors: Dmitry Grinko, Julien Gacon, Christa Zoufal, Stefan Woerner
supports: Adaptive angle intervals, confidence allocation and near-quadratic ideal query theorem.

title: Quantum speedup of Monte Carlo methods
supports: Bounded-output/variance assumptions and coherent mean estimation; author full text introduction checked at people.maths.bris.ac.uk/~csxam/papers/montecarlo.pdf.

title: Fast Quantum Algorithm for Numerical Gradient Estimation
supports: Finite-precision modular-addition oracle and phase-ramp gradient construction, smoothness requirements.

title: Variable time amplitude amplification and a faster quantum algorithm for solving systems of linear equations
supports: Section 2.1: coherent stopping flags, root-mean-square stopping time and maximum-time term.

title: An Efficient Quantum Factoring Algorithm
supports: Conditional factoring development, shorter repeated quantum circuits and classical lattice postprocessing.

title: Optimizing quantum optimization algorithms via faster quantum gradient computation
authors: András Gilyén, Srinivasan Arunachalam, Nathan Wiebe
supports: Audited omission/development: improved function-evaluation precision dependence and probability-to-phase oracle conversion, with smoothness assumptions.
